marketing.faq1Question: How does the free trial work?
marketing.faq1Answer: Every plan starts with a free trial. You are charged when it ends unless you cancel before then.
marketing.faq2Answer: Yes. Upgrade or downgrade from the billing page at any time; the price difference is shown before you confirm.
marketing.faq3Answer: Yes. Invite people by email and give each one the owner, admin or member role. Your plan sets how many seats you have.
marketing.faq4Answer: Cancel from the billing page. You keep access until the end of the period you paid for.
marketing.faq5Answer: Each workspace's data is kept separate, every request is checked on the server, and passwords are checked against known breaches.
marketing.faq6Answer: Email support from the help page and we will reply within one business day.
marketing.finalCtaSubhead: Sign up in a minute, invite your team and see if it fits before you pay.

pricing.faq1Question: What happens when the trial ends?
pricing.faq1Answer: Your plan starts and the card you added at checkout is charged. Cancel before the trial ends and you pay nothing.
pricing.faq2Question: Can I switch between monthly and yearly?
pricing.faq2Answer: Yes. Change your plan or billing interval from the billing page; the price difference is shown before you confirm.
pricing.faq3Question: What if I need more seats?
pricing.faq3Answer: Move to a larger plan from the billing page. Pending invitations count toward your seats.
